player_prompt.intro:
Owe udi wina Tower of Hanoi na {num_disks} disiki.
Owe udi fwanina disiki ku mutwi A kwenda ku mutwi C.
Ili osange disiki, leka mutwi wa kwanza na mutwi wa kukwela (ngwashi, '[A C]').
Kumbuka owe udi sangana disiki ya juu ya mutwi pe, na owe disiki ya nkubwa isangwekele kwa disiki ya ndogo.
Kwa kila zamu, ponzwele sangano limo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Owe udi kufingulula na mbidikitu ya kupelekelela '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Udi muambe ne: muaba anyi tshibumba tshidibu batuma ki ntshiakane to.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Uvua ukeba bua kuambula disete kampanda mu tshibumba tshivua katshiyi ne muntu.
invalid_move.same_tower: Nuakakeba bua kuya ne diske mu tshibumba tshimue atshi.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Uvua ukeba kuteka disete dinene pa dikese.

outcome.win: Tuasakidila, udi mujikije tshilumbu tshia tshibumba tshia Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Mbutshila bua dikudimuna bukadi bufike. Udi mufunde bimpe {pct} % ya disques ku tshibumba tshia C.
